gen-gf-grandstander-gf-khula: Khula reads as a plain sans with a tall midsection and curves that keep their mouths open. Grandstander is the one with the drawn-with-one-nib swagger up top, and Khula does the quieter job of staying easy underneath.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-krub: Chunky, bouncy, a bit cheeky. Krub brings a pronounced x-height and unfinished curves to the body, and that tension with Grandstander's heavy round letters is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-kufam: Kufam reads like a single neon tube bent into shape, with generously open curves in the e and hardly any ascenders showing. Grandstander sits above it and gives that glow a loud, friendly headline.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend: Round, loud and friendly. Grandstander does its best work shouting in bold, expressive display letters, while Lexend, a plain sans with outsized lowercase and open jaws on every curve, does its best work staying out of the way.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend-deca: Grandstander brings the bold, expressive punch, with short ascenders and a tall x-height that fill a headline. Lexend Deca does the opposite job, a sans-serif with an unshaded line and small-looking capitals that simply lets the words speak.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-liter: Liter is a sans with no stroke contrast at all. Grandstander's bold, expressive display letters set against that tall, wide-mouthed lowercase make the pair's strongest quality an easy handoff from loud to steady.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mada: Approachable from the first line, Mada leans on curves that refuse to close and a towering midzone. And Grandstander's unvarying weight from word to word gives that sans a bold, expressive partner that never wobbles.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-martel-sans: Big, blunt and friendly, with every stroke of Grandstander carrying the same visual weight as its neighbor. Martel Sans follows in generous curves and a high mean line, so a long passage would move along smoothly.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-matangi: Twine-like strokes, quietly hefty. Grandstander's bold display letters would feel cramped if the heading were made small, whereas Matangi, a sans with open rounded letters and a weighty lowercase, is happy filling the body.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-maven-pro: Welcoming is the mood Maven Pro sets, with a gentle gap in the c, a high-waisted lowercase and a line of steady thickness. Grandstander shouts above it, and the two split the page into loud and quiet.
